        Here is the patch content:
        From 783cf673b05ebf290317f583ee7eb6967ed9c964 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Weihang Li <liweihang@huawei.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2021 10:44:29 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/hns: Fix memory corruption when allocating XRCDN

It's incorrect to cast the type of pointer to xrcdn from (u32 *) to
(unsigned long *), then pass it into hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(), this will
lead to a memory corruption.

Fixes: 32548870d438 ("RDMA/hns: Add support for XRC on HIP09")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1616381069-51759-1-git-send-email-liweihang@huawei.com
Reported-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Weihang Li <liweihang@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Leon Romanovsky <leonro@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>
---
 drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c | 12 ++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
index 3ca51ce1813a..a5813bf567b2 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
@@ -140,8 +140,16 @@ void hns_roce_cleanup_uar_table(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev)
 
 static int hns_roce_xrcd_alloc(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev, u32 *xrcdn)
 {
-	return hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap,
-				     (unsigned long *)xrcdn);
+	unsigned long obj;
+	int ret;
+
+	ret = hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap, &obj);
+	if (ret)
+		return ret;
+
+	*xrcdn = obj;
+
+	return 0;
 }
 
 static void hns_roce_xrcd_free(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev,
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrectly casting a pointer of type `u32 *` to `unsigned long *` when passing it to the `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()` function. This type mismatch could lead to memory corruption, as the function expected a pointer to an `unsigned long`, but was instead given a pointer to a `u32`, potentially causing misalignment and incorrect memory access. The fix involved allocating an `unsigned long` variable and then assigning its value to the `xrcdn` pointer after the allocation, ensuring proper type compatibility and preventing memory corruption.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly casting a pointer of type `u32 *` to `unsigned long *` when passing it to the `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()` function. This type mismatch could lead to memory corruption, as the function expected a pointer to an `unsigned long`, but was instead given a pointer to a `u32`, potentially causing misalignment and incorrect memory access. The fix involved allocating an `unsigned long` variable and then assigning its value to the `xrcdn` pointer after the allocation, ensuring proper type compatibility and preventing memory corruption.
